newsitem.title: FRANCE: French committee to look at Framatome sale.
newsitem.headline: French committee to look at Framatome sale.

text.p: A committee of the National Assembly, the lower house of the French parliament, has set up a study group to look at the planned sale of nuclear engineering group Framatome, the committee chairman told Reuters on Wednesday.
"We have decided to set up a study group on the consequences for the French nuclear-generated electricity sector of a change in status for Framatome," said Francois-Michel Gonnot.

The group, which will not have a time limit unlike parliamentary inquiries, will consist of two parliamentarians, Claude Birraux of the conservative UDF party and Yvon Jacob of the conservative RPR party.
The government said on August 30 it would allow Franco-British GEC Alsthom to study a possible merger with Framatome, which makes nuclear power stations.
GEC Alsthom is a joint venture between Alcatel Alsthom and GEC Plc.
